summary: Held the entire episode. Price moved favorably from entry almost immediately and stayed net positive throughout (peaking ~+54 to +82pts on the amplitude), with several sharp but temporary pullbacks (giveback spiking to 37-52% a few times) that each recovered within 1-2 frames rather than compounding into new lows - classic dip-and-resolve behavior, not a wrong-direction entry. No frame showed price crossing to net negative or a sustained breakdown, so there was never a wrong-direction signal to act on. Next time I'd watch for a pullback that fails to reclaim at least half its giveback within 2 frames, or a fire cluster (HA/PROPP/KMDR all against simultaneously) persisting 3+ frames, as the earlier trigger for a bail rather than waiting for price to go outright negative.
